name: Fitchburg Art Museum
source: Fitchburg Art Museum: visitor map (January 2026), exhibition pages and the FESTIVAL catalogue
note: The Fitchburg Art Museum has over 7,000 works and no online catalogue yet (it is taking a full inventory). Listed here is what it publishes about the shows on view now: every object in FESTIVAL: A Celebration of African Art (from its catalogue, until December 13, 2026), the works its Kaleidoscope press release names (500+ works upstairs to July 2027), Heirlooms, and the public art outside.
